tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Dallas, Texas

about: Brad M. LaMorgese is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Dallas, Texas area. Providing legal representation in Texas for a variety of different issues, Brad LaMorgese was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Brad M. LaMorgese attended law school. Brad LaMorgese was enrolled at Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1996. Brad LaMorgese was admitted to the practice of law in 1996.

Attorneys like Brad M. LaMorgese are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Brad LaMorgese represents clients with Family Law issues. Additional legal issues represented include Appellate.
